class.name: NetwColumnRef
class.brief_description: One column of one schema, as a value a configuration call can hold.
class.description:
A column index is a bare [int], so index 0 of one schema and index 0 of another are the same value. A reference carries the schema too, which is what lets a binding refuse a column the entity never declared. [method NetwSchema.column_ref] mints one, and the reference holds its schema alive. The schema holds no reference back, so a [code]static var[/code] can keep both. [codeblock] class_name PlayerSave extends RefCounted
static var schema := NetwSchema.create(&"players").replicated(false) static var gold := schema.column_ref(schema.i64(&"gold")) static var position := schema.column_ref(schema.vector2(&"position")) [/codeblock] Per-tick code keeps using the [int] the declaration returned. A reference is for configuration, which runs once.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Whether [member schema] still declares a column at [member index]. A reference minted by [method NetwSchema.column_ref] is valid when it is made.

members.member: The column's address in [member schema], the same [int] its declaring method returned.
The column's declared name, or empty when [method is_valid] is [code]false[/code].
The schema this column belongs to.
